findings.claim: The fix only guards the `scope` parameter; other authorize parameters (e.g., `client_id`, `redirect_uri`, `state`) that arrive as arrays or non-strings are not guarded and may still cause 500s.
findings.test_or_reason: The ticket's recommendation mentions 'any other non-string authorize parameter', but the diff only adds a guard for `scope`.

findings.claim: The POST JSON-array body test (R2/R3) relies on `express.json()` being applied in the test setup, but the production route may not have that middleware in the same way; the test does not verify the production middleware stack.
findings.test_or_reason: The test constructs its own express app with `express.json()`, which may differ from the production app's middleware configuration.

findings.claim: The test does not cover the POST repeated-query-parameter carrier (e.g., `?scope=a&scope=b` on POST), even though the ticket lists it as a carrier.
findings.evidence: ks1219-authorize-refuses-an-array-valued-scope.test.ts:105-113 (only JSON array body tests for POST)
findings.test_or_reason: The ticket's BLUF mentions 'repeated query param on GET, the same on POST, JSON array body on POST', but the test file only has GET repeated param and POST JSON array.

findings.claim: The test does not assert that the 400 response body has the exact `invalid_request` message shape beyond `error.message`; it only checks `message` and status.
findings.test_or_reason: The test only checks `status` and `message`, not the full `error` object shape (e.g., `code`, `description`).

findings.claim: The test mocks `getAppByClientId` to return a fixed app, so it does not verify that the resolver's new guard runs before the client lookup; the guard is placed after RULE 1 and client_id checks, so a missing client_id would still return 400 before the scope check.
findings.evidence: routes/oauth.ts:396 (guard placed after RULE 1 and client_id checks at lines 243-253)
findings.test_or_reason: The test always provides a valid client_id, so it does not exercise the ordering of the scope guard relative to other validations.

findings.claim: The test file's comment claims 'the same mocks as ks804-authorize-get-post-agree-per-rule.test.ts', but the mock for `../services/oauth` spreads the real module and overrides only some functions; this may not be identical to the referenced test's mocks.
findings.test_or_reason: The comment asserts sameness without evidence; the mock structure may differ from the referenced test.

findings.claim: The fix does not change the POST handler's catch block, which still returns 500 for any uncaught error; the new guard only prevents the specific array-scope TypeError, but other malformed inputs (e.g., array `client_id`) could still 500.
findings.evidence: routes/oauth.ts:801-804 `catch (error: any) { logger.error('OAuth authorize POST error', ...); res.status(500)... }`
findings.test_or_reason: The guard is narrow; the ticket's recommendation to refuse any non-string authorize parameter is not fully implemented.

findings.claim: The test does not verify that the 400 response is returned before any side effects (e.g., no code minted) for the GET carrier; only the POST approve test checks `createAuthorizationCode` not called.
findings.test_or_reason: GET does not mint codes, but the test does not assert that the consent page is not served or that no other side effect occurs.
